items.headline: Bear of the Day: Albemarle Corporation (ALB)
items.snippet: Albemarle, the world's largest lithium producer, has suffered as lithium prices tanked ~80% from late 2022 highs. Downward earnings revisions earn Zacks Rank #5 (Strong Sell). Q3 EPS outlook down 13%, Q4 down 36% since Q2 release.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus lowered PT to $135 from $230, keeps Buy. Lithium price up ~67% YoY, supply/demand poised to improve into 2027.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $175 from $200 at BMO Capital
items.snippet: BMO lowered PT to $175 from $200, Outperform, following recent lithium spot price weakness; group viewed as oversold.

items.headline: Albemarle Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
items.snippet: Management emphasized tight lithium market on strong EV and stationary storage demand; lithium demand +45% through May; maintained 2026 outlook, high end of scenario ranges.
